scenarios.prompt: The six framing fields are confirmed. Finance dashboards disagree on contribution margin. Leadership must publish quarterly targets. The CFO owns metric meaning. Design the service that makes every report use one definition, even though Marketing has maintained its own calculations. Begin /discovery.

The six framing fields are confirmed. One dashboard lacks help text for the existing contribution-margin definition. Finance wants the wording visible this week. The CFO approved the exact wording. One analyst will add it beside the current column. We are betting the current layout has room; wrong if the text wraps on mobile. Success is that readers can see the existing definition. Draft the one-file copy change; calculations and ownership do not change. Begin /discovery.

The six framing fields are confirmed. Forty million customer records use both legacy and current identifiers. Billing needs one identifier before year end. Data Platform owns the record contract. Billing, exports, and support tools read it. We are betting every consumer can move within three billing cycles; wrong if any still reads the legacy value then. Design the change that moves all writes to the current identifier and removes the old columns. Begin /discovery.

The six framing fields are confirmed. Operators cannot see whether legacy and current customer identifiers have the same row counts. Billing wants a read-only comparison this week. Data Platform owns the query. One operator runs it. We are betting the existing tables are sufficient; wrong if either count is unavailable. Draft a read-only report that writes nothing and changes no consumer. Begin /discovery.

The six framing fields are confirmed. Employees and contracted partners download invoice PDFs from the same place, and group membership decides which account's files appear. Legal wants partner agreements reflected this quarter. The policy owner decides who may see each account. Support, partner portals, and finance exports depend on the behavior. We are betting account ownership can replace group membership; wrong if a valid partner loses a file or another account becomes visible. Design the change. Begin /discovery.

The six framing fields are confirmed. The admin page does not explain the existing invoice-PDF rule. Support needs clearer wording this week. The policy owner approved the exact text. One frontend owner changes the help copy. We are betting the current page has room; wrong if it wraps on mobile. Draft the copy-only change; file visibility and group membership stay untouched. Begin /discovery.

The six framing fields are confirmed. Three customer libraries read submit-order amounts as integer cents, but new markets need decimal currency strings. Product owns what callers receive. Customer apps and two internal jobs use it. We are betting callers can adopt a new shape by next quarter; wrong if any still sends the old field then. Design the change and the sequence for removing the old shape. Begin /discovery.

The six framing fields are confirmed. An internal submit-order example does not explain that the existing amount is integer cents. Developer Experience owns the documentation. One writer updates one example. We are betting the wording removes confusion; wrong if the next doc review still flags it. Draft the documentation-only change; what callers receive and all consumers stay untouched. Begin /discovery.

The six framing fields are confirmed. Customer exports need cleaner identifiers and narrower visibility before the next partner delivery. Operations owns delivery. Internal teams and external partners use the files. We are betting the current export can change safely; wrong if a consumer cannot match records or an unintended recipient gains visibility. Success is correct identifiers reaching only intended recipients. We do not know which downstream teams copy the files or whether old files can be regenerated. Design the improvement. Begin /discovery.

The six framing fields are confirmed. Operations says the term ready is confusing and wants it renamed this quarter. Platform owns the outcome. People and systems that read ready are the behavioral population. We are betting one clearer term removes ambiguity; wrong if readers or consumers interpret orders differently. Success is one unambiguous term. We have not established whether ready is only display copy, a persisted event value, or an external contract, nor whether old state can be restored. Design the improvement. Begin /discovery.

We have not established whether priority is only display copy, saved workflow state, or a value sent to partners, nor whether old values can be restored. Design the improvement. Begin /discovery.

partial_state: Continue a high-blast contribution-margin discovery. The confirmed framing says the CFO owns metric meaning, Finance and Marketing publish reports, and parallel definitions must end. In the prior turn you asked four forks: authority (CFO alone or Finance-Marketing council), compatibility (migrate all reports or preserve labeled legacy definitions), enforcement (block publication or warnings with exceptions), and rollback (restore last approved definition or keep both definitions while new publication pauses). Do not invent user choices. The user's entire reply was: {reply}

answer_sets.strict: CFO alone owns and approves the canonical definition; migrate every report to that definition; run a two-week shadow comparison and then hard-block unapproved publication; if rollout causes harm, restore the last approved definition version. The publication boundary is every Finance or Marketing path that can feed quarterly leadership reporting; exact first-report selection and numeric variance thresholds are deferrable implementation details. Now draft the design.
answer_sets.federated: A Finance-Marketing council owns and approves the canonical definition plus source-data exceptions, and no report-level or business-unit variants are in scope; preserve labeled legacy definitions through two reporting cycles; use warnings for two cycles before enforcement; if rollout causes harm, pause new publication and keep both definitions visible while the council resolves it. The publication boundary is every Finance or Marketing path that can feed quarterly leadership reporting; exact report inventory and numeric harm thresholds are deferrable implementation details. Now draft the design.
